name: Orufrey Weekend
source:
ORUFREY WEEKEND is a Witch Hat Atelier fangame in which you take on the role of Coco, an apprentice. You and your friends have a bit of a plan...

Affect Qifrey & Olruggio's Mood points with choices and items, so that their Heart Points might increase.

(But would it really be such a good idea to raise Qifrey's Heart Points too far...?)

[from [url=https://cobaltstarsky.itch.io/orufreyweekend]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《奥路奇夫周末》（ORUFREY WEEKEND）是一部《尖帽子的魔法工坊》同人游戏，你将扮演见习魔女可可——你和伙伴们正暗中谋划着一个小计划……

通过对话选项与道具左右奇夫利和奥路基奥的“心情值”，从而提升两人的“心动值”吧。

（不过，把奇夫利的心动值刷得太高，真的会是个好主意吗……？）

[摘自[url=https://cobaltstarsky.itch.io/orufreyweekend]itch.io[/url]]
